[SWS_DM_01259] Validation of Security Level Locked in
ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSecurityLevelShortName
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04005
⌈
If the application calls the
ara::diag::Conversation::GetDiagnosticSecu-
rityLevelShortName
with the parameter
securityLevel
set to
kLocked
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall return error code
kInvalidArgument
.
⌋
